description: Apply services live. Changes the services of a running computer now, without updating the project: send the whole `.homemade/config.jsonc` text as `config` (or the `services` map). New and changed services start, removed ones stop, unchanged ones keep running, and their links follow. Only `services` take effect; other changed keys are listed in `needsImageUpdate`. Answers each service's health.

config.description: The whole `.homemade/config.jsonc` text. Only its `services` take effect now.

restart.description: Services to start again even when they did not change.

condition.description: "healthy" (default): wait until the dependency reports healthy (its `healthcheck`, or something listening on its `port`). "started": wait only until its terminal started.

depends_on.description: Services this one waits for before its `cmd` starts, by name, each with a `condition` ("healthy" by default, or "started"). Replaces sleep loops: a web service waits for its database, however long it takes. If a dependency exits, this service does not start and its terminal says why; it starts once the dependency is restarted and healthy.

displayName.description: Human-friendly name shown instead of the service key in the dashboard.

healthcheck.description: Probe the service over localhost HTTP (guest-side) and report health on the `health` command / VM runtime. Success is any HTTP status below 500 — a 404 still counts as up. Requires `port`.

cmd.description: A shell command probed instead of HTTP, run as the VM user in the workspace: exit code 0 counts as up. Needs no `port`.

path.description: HTTP path probed on the service's own port (http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}). Default "/".

threshold.description: Consecutive failing probes before the service flips to unhealthy. Any single success flips it back to healthy. Default 6.

hidden.description: Hide the service from the VM workspace's Services pane. Does not affect autostart, and does not stop the service's own terminal from existing.

icon.description: A short text/emoji glyph shown next to the service — rendered as literal text, never fetched as an image.

order.description: Sort position among services in the dashboard (ascending). Services without an order sort after those with one.

publicHost.description: By default the preview proxy hands the app each request as if it came to http://localhost:<port> (Host, Origin and Referer rewritten; redirects to localhost:<port> rewritten back to the preview URL), so dev servers' host checks (Vite allowedHosts, Django ALLOWED_HOSTS, Rails config.hosts, Next allowedDevOrigins) pass with no app config. true sends the real preview hostname with X-Forwarded-Host/Proto instead, for apps that need it (multi-tenant hosts, absolute URLs built from the request). Only meaningful when `url` is true.

share.description: Who may open the service's public URL. "public": anyone with the link. "authenticated": members of the organization that owns the VM. "owner": only the user who created the VM (platform admins always allowed). Only meaningful when `url` is true.

signInUrl.description: A per-VM sign-in or pairing link the VM page shows under the service, with copy and open buttons. A template: ${HOMEMADE_URL_<port>} is that port's VM URL, ${KEY} the value of the VM's env var KEY (e.g. one `generate: true` in env_schema). Only meaningful when `url` is true.

services.description: The new services, in the config's `services` shape, instead of `config`.

name: services_apply
title: Apply services live
